_comment: Campaign 30 (2026-11-12). The c29 recipe continued from c29's final best (gen 43) with an empty replay buffer. Launch: scripts/box/resume.sh configs/run_c30.json checkpoints/campaign29/gen_0043.pt. What changed against c29: (1) the engine carries the Throne Room/Vassal + Library fix (all of c29 ran before it); (2) evals and the engine3 gate match now score terminal nodes on the margin scale the value head is trained on (c29 scored them +-1 there, so c30 engine3 numbers are not comparable with c29's; self-play and the paired gate always used the margin scale, and the training target is unchanged); (3) self-play workers free their runner at the end of a generation, which removes the out-of-memory kill at every c28/c29 generation boundary; (4) stricter gate: 800 games, promote only when score minus TWO paired standard errors exceeds 0.5 (about 53%, false promotion about 2%; c29 used 400 games and one standard error, about 16%); (5) stop rule: the trainer exits cleanly after 10 generations in a row without a promotion and writes checkpoints/campaign30/STOPPED (delete it to continue). Learning rate picks up where c29 gen 43 was (1.4e-4, cosine to 5e-5 over 60 generations). Progress is also measured every 5th generation against the fixed anchor c29 gen 43 (scripts/box/ladder_watch.sh, 200 paired boards at 128 sims, bench/c30_ladder). Unchanged open choice: self-play is clairvoyant (determinize off) while the gate and evals are honest. Changed 2026-11-12 after gen 6 (Jack): the 2x100 engine3 eval runs for every generation the gate accepts (eval_on_accept) instead of every 5th generation. Changed 2026-11-12 after gen 11 (Jack): the engine3 check no longer vetoes a candidate that wins the head-to-head (it rejected gen 8 on a 6-point gap, inside the noise of two 200-game matches); gate_third_party_opponent is empty and engine3 strength is read from the eval that runs on every accepted generation.
